name: B10-0516/2026 (ESN) – Case of Paata Burchuladze and political prisoners under the Georgian Dream Regime
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Paata Burchuladze and political prisoners under the Georgian Dream Regime
part_text:
This is a motion for a resolution from a political group, not a law. It does not change any rules. It expresses concern about the prison sentences given to Paata Burchuladze and other opposition figures in Georgia, and it rejects seizing power by force. It calls for dialogue between the government and the opposition, and it asks the European Union to respect Georgia's democratic processes and avoid pressure and sanctions.

- Nothing changes in law; the text only states a political position.
- It concerns Georgia's government, opposition and the European Union.
- It would be sent to European Union bodies and to Georgia's leaders.
